name: jev
title: jev · typed questions over the Jev model
description: Complete wrapper over jevgo, the Go client for TypeSafe AI's System One API and its Jev model (github.com/fgn/jevgo). One static Go bridge binary does every call — client options, retries, error sentinels — and mod.py is a thin shell onto it: ask typed questions (noul yes/no, choice, score) about any state and get probability distributions back, or list models. Key via TYPESAFE_API_KEY only, never stored here.

env.TYPESAFE_API_KEY: required — System One API key (secret, env only)

notes.bridge: src/cmd/jevbridge — every network call goes through the Go client; Python never speaks the protocol itself, so the CLI and the library can never disagree with jevgo
notes.questions: System One takes a state plus named questions: noul (probability of yes), choice (pick an option, per-option probabilities), score (position against ordered levels, per-level probabilities), raw (pass-through for unknown kinds)
notes.errors: jevgo sentinels surface as {error, code}: bad_request, authentication, permission_denied, not_found, unprocessable, rate_limit, overloaded, internal, connection, timeout, invalid_request
notes.secrets: API key is read from the environment by the Go binary; it is never written to config.json or any file in this module
